# Calculate precision and recall at a certain threshold t.
PrecisionRecall <- function(predictions, data, threshold) {
  .pt <- ifelse(predictions <= threshold, 0, 1)
  .m <- table(factor(.pt, levels=c(0,1)), factor(data, levels=c(0,1)))
  .gt <- sum(.m)
  .prec <- .m["1","1"]/sum(.m["1",])
  .prec <- ifelse(is.na(.prec), 0, .prec)
  .rec <- .m["1","1"]/sum(.m[,"1"])
  .rec <- ifelse(is.na(.rec), 0, .rec)
  list(Precision = .prec, Recall = .rec)
}

# Calculate the proportion of correct predictions at threshold t.
Correct <- function(predictions, data, threshold) {
  .pt <- ifelse(predictions <= threshold, 0, 1)
  .m <- table(.pt==data)
  .m[2]/sum(.m)
}
